lodges.name: Spruce Hill Lodge
lodges.imageAlt: Spruce Hill Lodge glowing at dusk
lodges.shortDesc: Lakeside boathouse charm with panoramic peaks, a private dock and sunrise views from every window.
lodges.description: A mountain lodge above the valley with panoramic peaks, a private dock below and golden light in every room. Perfect for families who want lakeside calm with alpine views, slow mornings and evenings by the fire.
included: Local host support 7 days a week

lodges.name: Evergreen Pine Family Lodge
lodges.imageAlt: Evergreen Pine Family Lodge with warm orange windows in the misty forest
lodges.shortDesc: The lodge from our cover shot — golden windows in the pines, a wraparound deck, and total quiet for the whole family.
lodges.description: The lodge from our cover shot — golden windows glowing in the pines, a wraparound deck and total quiet for the whole family. Self check-in, a wood-fired sauna and forest trails starting right at your door.
included: Self check-in door code on arrival day

lodges.name: Lakeside Boathouse Cabin
lodges.imageAlt: Lakeside Boathouse Cabin in a golden meadow beneath mountain peaks
lodges.shortDesc: Fall asleep to water sounds. Golden windows, a wraparound porch, and kayaks waiting at your door.
lodges.description: Fall asleep to water sounds in this cosy boathouse cabin. Golden windows, a wraparound porch and kayaks waiting at your door — made for slow lake days, sunrise paddles and fireside evenings.

lodges.name: Forest Log Hideaway
lodges.imageAlt: Forest Log Hideaway — small red cabin by a still forest lake
lodges.shortDesc: A cosy couples' escape — one room, one lake, zero distractions. Perfect for a slow weekend.
lodges.description: A cosy couples' escape — one room, one lake, zero distractions. No TV by design, just a wood stove, a private deck over the water and the forest all around you for a truly slow weekend.
included: Self check-in door code on arrival day

lodges.name: Alpine Glass Lodge
lodges.imageAlt: Alpine Glass Lodge with snowy mountain views
lodges.shortDesc: Floor-to-ceiling glass, a grand stone fireplace inside, and snow peaks in every direction.
lodges.description: Floor-to-ceiling glass, a grand stone fireplace inside and snow peaks in every direction. Watch storms and sunrises from bed, soak in the hot tub under the stars, and cook in a chef-grade kitchen.
included: Private hot tub, cleaned before arrival

lodges.name: The Grand Timber Lodge
lodges.imageAlt: The Grand Timber Lodge interior with fireplace and wooden beams
lodges.shortDesc: Vaulted timber ceilings, a roaring stone fireplace, and room for everyone you love.
lodges.description: Vaulted timber ceilings, a roaring stone fireplace and room for everyone you love. A games room, hot tub and full kitchen make this the lodge for big family gatherings and long, loud, happy evenings.
included: Self check-in door code on arrival day
